_status: TECHNICAL DEMONSTRATION ONLY. Not clinician-approved. Not for patient care.
_purpose: Handwritten target output for the Role 5 compiler. Every row here is written by hand; keys starting with '_' are review annotations and are not written to the XLSForm.
_source_document: WHO, Integrated Management of Childhood Illness (IMCI) Chart Booklet, March 2014. PDF sha256 d10fd1d040bdbdb6db4254b8095e1d1722d0a3d2f80c3651b3003301a8a6959f. 'p.N' below means page N of that PDF file.

survey.name: _id
survey.label::en: Which child are you assessing?

survey.name: patient_uuid
survey._convention: Top-level patient_uuid/patient_id link the report to the contact (cht-ai-tools cht-forms.md section 6)

survey.name: in_scope
survey._source: p.5-6: chart applies to 'SICK CHILD AGE 2 MONTHS UP TO 5 YEARS'

survey.name: intro
survey.label::en: Child cough and fast breathing (demonstration)

survey.name: demo_banner
survey.label::en: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. This form is not clinician-approved and must not be used for patient care.

survey.name: age_unknown_note
survey.label::en: This child has no date of birth recorded, so this form cannot be used.

survey.name: out_of_scope_note
survey.label::en: This form only covers children aged 2 months up to 5 years. Do not use it for this child.
survey._ambiguity: A2 (what the CHW should do instead is not specified)

survey.name: has_cough_or_difficult_breathing
survey.label::en: Does the child have cough or difficult breathing?
survey._source: p.6: 'Does the child have cough or difficult breathing?'

survey.name: danger_signs
survey.label::en: General danger signs
survey._source: p.5: CHECK FOR GENERAL DANGER SIGNS
survey._ambiguity: A3 (WHO checks danger signs for every sick child, not only those with cough)

survey.name: not_able_to_drink_or_breastfeed
survey.label::en: Is the child NOT able to drink or breastfeed?
survey._source: p.5 'Is the child able to drink or breastfeed?'; phrased as the sign itself per p.64 'NOT ABLE TO DRINK OR BREASTFEED'

survey.name: vomits_everything
survey.label::en: Does the child vomit everything?

survey.name: had_convulsions
survey.label::en: Has the child had convulsions?

survey.name: lethargic_or_unconscious
survey.label::en: Is the child lethargic or unconscious?

survey.name: convulsing_now
survey.label::en: Is the child convulsing now?

survey.name: breathing
survey.label::en: Breathing

survey.name: calm_child_note
survey.label::en: The child must be calm while you count breaths and look and listen.

survey.name: breaths_per_minute
survey.label::en: Count the breaths in one minute. How many breaths per minute?
survey.constraint_message::en: Enter the number of breaths counted in one minute.
survey._source: p.6 'Count the breaths in one minute'
survey._ambiguity: A6 (no plausible upper bound given; '. >= 0' is a technical check only)

survey.name: chest_indrawing
survey.label::en: Do you see chest indrawing?

survey.name: stridor_in_calm_child
survey.label::en: Do you hear stridor while the child is calm?
survey._source: p.6 'Look and listen for stridor' / 'Stridor in calm child'

survey.name: fast_breathing
survey._source: p.6 '2 months up to 12 months: 50 breaths per minute or more; 12 Months up to 5 years: 40 breaths per minute or more'; '... or more' => greater than or equal
survey._convention: Literal thresholds per age band, no field-to-field comparison (matches docs/logic-model-v1-proposal.md)

survey.name: any_general_danger_sign
survey.calculation: if(selected(${not_able_to_drink_or_breastfeed}, 'yes') or selected(${vomits_everything}, 'yes') or selected(${had_convulsions}, 'yes') or selected(${lethargic_or_unconscious}, 'yes') or selected(${convulsing_now}, 'yes'), 'yes', if(selected(${not_able_to_drink_or_breastfeed}, 'no') and selected(${vomits_everything}, 'no') and selected(${had_convulsions}, 'no') and selected(${lethargic_or_unconscious}, 'no') and selected(${convulsing_now}, 'no'), 'no', ''))
survey._convention: yes / no / '' (unknown) pattern from r_danger_sign_present in pregnancy_danger_sign.xlsx

survey.name: classification
survey.calculation: if(${in_scope} = 'unknown', 'age_unknown', if(${in_scope} = 'no', 'out_of_scope', if(selected(${has_cough_or_difficult_breathing}, 'no'), 'not_in_pathway', if(${any_general_danger_sign} = 'yes' or selected(${stridor_in_calm_child}, 'yes'), 'severe_pneumonia_or_very_severe_disease', if(${any_general_danger_sign} = 'no' and selected(${stridor_in_calm_child}, 'no') and (selected(${chest_indrawing}, 'yes') or ${fast_breathing} = 'yes'), 'pneumonia', if(${any_general_danger_sign} = 'no' and selected(${stridor_in_calm_child}, 'no') and selected(${chest_indrawing}, 'no') and ${fast_breathing} = 'no', 'cough_or_cold', 'incomplete'))))))
survey._source: p.6 classification table: Pink SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE / Yellow PNEUMONIA / Green COUGH OR COLD

survey.name: follow_up_days
survey._source: p.6 PNEUMONIA 'Follow-up in 3 days'; COUGH OR COLD 'Follow-up in 5 days if not improving'
survey._ambiguity: A5 ('if not improving' is not captured)

survey.name: summary
survey.label::en: Summary

survey.name: summary_demo_banner
survey.label::en: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. Not clinician-approved.

survey.name: summary_severe
survey.label::en: SEVERE PNEUMONIA OR VERY SEVERE DISEASE. Refer URGENTLY to hospital.

survey.name: summary_pneumonia
survey.label::en: PNEUMONIA. Follow up in 3 days.

survey.name: summary_cough_or_cold
survey.label::en: COUGH OR COLD. Follow up in 5 days if not improving.

survey.name: summary_not_in_pathway
survey.label::en: No cough or difficult breathing. This form does not assess other problems.

survey.name: summary_out_of_scope
survey.label::en: Child is outside the 2 months to 5 years age range. No classification was made.

settings._note: Fixed version string instead of =NOW() so the output is reproducible
